source.stem:
The diagram shows a circuit containing a cell, an ammeter, a lamp and a variable resistor.
The resistance of the variable resistor is increased.
What happens to the ammeter reading and what happens to the brightness of the lamp?

options.text: ammeter reading decreases; lamp brightness decreases
ammeter reading decreases; lamp brightness increases
ammeter reading increases; lamp brightness decreases
ammeter reading increases; lamp brightness increases

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Electricity: magnetic and heating effects. The student must decide: Identify whether a setup is a working Voltaic cell by checking for two different metal electrodes and an electrolyte. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
